stem.text: The diagram shows the amino acids in a polypeptide.

stem.text: An enzyme catalyses the hydrolysis of **any** peptide bond between a non-polar amino acid **and** any polar amino acid.
How many small peptides and single amino acids will be formed by the action of this enzyme?
